trait.name: Fire's Burn
trait.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it, you can deal an additional 1d10 Fire damage to that target. You can do so a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

trait.name: Born of Flame
trait.description: You have 50 percent resistance to Fire damage. This does not independently grant immunity to effects that deal Fire damage.

trait.name: Searing Ignition
trait.description: On your turn while taking the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a burst of Fire centered on you. Each creature you choose within 15 feet makes a Dexterity saving throw. On failure, it takes 1d8 plus your Proficiency Bonus Fire damage and is Blinded until the start of your next turn; on success, it takes half damage and is not Blinded. Proficiency Bonus uses per Long Rest, once per turn.
